evidence.t: About 18 wetlands within 2 km (estimate): ducks move between them.

Elevation 842 m: under 900 m, open water later in fall.

seasonRows.notes: District 6. Within the 8 a day: 4 northern pintails, 4 canvasbacks, 2 Barrow's or common goldeneyes together, 2 harlequins. Possession 24: 12, 12, 6, 6.

plan: Drive: from Iskut, about 51 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 57.62463, -129.46048, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.9 km NW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 35 m, about 122 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 30 m NE of the spot at 842 m (57.67107, -129.50832). Water: unnamed wetland 30 m W (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 6-20, Region 6. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-06-12, closures 2026-10-16.
R6P-duck-backcountry-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 6-20: about 2,921 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.21 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
